entry.notes: The directly inspected frozen CultureMech recipes explicitly name Silicone antifoam(BDH), with source-specific citations and preserved excerpts attributed to Verduyn1992 andFlikweert1996. The original PDFs were not independently retrieved: timeouts and an explicit approval refusal are recorded. The bounded material is the BDH silicone-antifoam preparation reported by those recipe records, not a verified catalogue number, silicone molecular species or fixed-strength emulsion. Original quotation verification remains an operational publication-evidence limitation.

JCM1182 explicitly supplies Cr2(SO4)3·xH2O. The actual Cr2_So43_X_N_H2o.yaml already represents the same variable hydrate, so no duplicate is created. Sigma primary specification identifies CAS15244-38-9 for Cr2(SO4)3·xH2O. Fresh OLS search did not establish an exact hydrate ontology term; retain CHEBI53471 chromium(III)sulfate only as asymmetric parent. Sigma anhydrous-basis molecular weight and fixed-hydrate widgets are not copied. Existing role/release obligations remain open.

TOGO M2313 explicitly names larch arabinogalactan as an alternative carbon substrate at0.2%, with percent basis unspecified. Larch provenance differentiates the material from unrestricted arabinogalactan. Sigma primary botanical material confirms that larch-wood arabinogalactan is a meaningful purchasable material; its catalogue, assay, species and extraction process are not assigned to this recipe. The closest verified ontology parent is CHEBI27569 arabinogalactan; natural-polymer identity is not decomposed into free monosaccharides.

DSMZ1132 instead explicitly specifies Fe-NH4EDTA(4mg/ml),1.0ml; its four frozen derivatives refer to a stock, not weighed pure salt. Propose separate exact salt and source-qualified4mg/mLstock, preserving raw label ambiguity and receiving-medium errors.

This record denotes that fruit-pulp material; it does not denote the boiled/strained extract, whole cherries, agar, an exact cultivar, or a specified species. DSMZ1555 specifies lipoprotein concentrate (LPC; MPBiomedical) as a 0.1% receiving-medium addition. This owner denotes the named manufacturer-associated concentrate at that source scope. The source does not specify a catalogue number, exact cholesterol content, organism origin or complete formulation; none is inferred from current manufacturer examples. The 0.1% is the receiving dose, not a concentration of the supplied concentrate. Named material curation does not require an exact ontology product term.
Generic ox bile is a verified broader material parent; the local ingredient identity preserves the explicitly desiccated preparation rather than identifying it with every fresh/dried bile material.

The source ingredient is desiccated ox bile, a dried bovine bile material. NBRC1004 and NBRC1390 independently name desiccated ox bile as a weighed dry ingredient; Sigma70168 confirms the material is produced by dehydrating fresh ox bile. This is neither fresh liquid bile nor an isolated bile salt, and no supplier-specific grade or constituent concentration is asserted. Generic ox-bile owners and Oxgall are recorded reconciliation candidates, not automatically merged or equated to this explicitly dried material.

DSMZ885 identifies poly(hexamethylene carbonate), PHC, from Toagosei with number-average molecular mass 2000, and lists Plysurf A210G surfactant separately. This is the polymer ingredient; its chain-length distribution and undisclosed end groups do not make its identity unknown. The emulsion and entire PHC medium are distinct preparations. The Beijing environmental authority chemical inventory entry11389 independently identifies CAS61630-98-6 as the carbonate polymer of1,6-hexanediol, also called polycarbonate diol; the supplier TechServe Solutions explicitly names poly(hexamethylene carbonate) diol under that CAS. These corroborate the source CAS at its registered polymer scope, without selecting a new grade or assigning a fixed chain length. CommonChemistry API401, its navigation-only HTML and the publisher403 are unsuccessful verification routes, not negative chemical findings. No fixed molecular formula, molecular weight, end-group structure, or monomer components are asserted.

CHEBI61433 is polycarbonate polymer, a broader polymer class. Exact-name search retrieved copolymers with different comonomers, not this homopolycarbonate. CAS primary and asymmetric parent grounding follow MAPPING_SEMANTICS section3; variable chain length does not justify bypassing a verified polymer registration.

Entry11389 identifies CAS61630-98-6 as1,3-dioxolan-2-one polymer with1,6-hexanediol, polycarbonate diol. Supplier https://www.techservesolutions.in/en/products/poly-hexamethylene-carbonate-diol-61630-98-6 explicitly names poly(hexamethylene carbonate) diol under the same CAS. No fixed degree of polymerization or new source-grade equivalence is inferred.
